video_title: Ancient Child Fossil SHATTERS Human Evolution Timeline!
script: What if a single fossil could rewrite our entire human family tree? A 3-million-year-old child's remains have just done exactly that, throwing a major twist into human evolution! For decades, we believed early human ancestors developed key traits in a clear, sequential order. We thought we understood the timeline. But this ancient child, an early hominin, reveals a startling mix. It walked upright, yet still had strong adaptations for climbing trees – a combination previously thought impossible at this stage. This single discovery forces experts to re-evaluate when and how crucial human characteristics truly emerged. Our evolutionary past is far more complex than we ever imagined.
